# Kay

> Kay is a Bun web framework. A `.kay` file is one component: TypeScript fences, then a pug-like indented template. Pages render to plain HTML strings on the server, islands run on kay's own signals and DOM runtime, and an Elysia plugin serves it all with automatic islands. Everything is typed, templates included, and `kay check` reports errors at the `.kay` line and column.

## Rules that are easy to get wrong

- Every dynamic value sits in `{}`: `a(href={url})`, `p Hello {name}`. A static attribute value is a quoted string: `a(href="/about")`.
- A signal or memo the script declares is read by its name in the template, `{count}`, and by calling it in the script, `count()`; it is written with `count.set(1)` or `count.set(c => c + 1)`. In the template, `count.set`, `bind:value={count}` and a call, `count()`, still take the signal itself, and a component handed `open={open}` gets the value, kept current; one that writes it takes `onToggle={open.set}`, or the signal under a name of its own, `const openState = open`. Only a signal or memo the script itself makes reads by name: one imported from a module, or a prop holding one, is called, `accent()`, and in the script a signal is always called, as `items.length` there is the function's. Rendered as text, `{accent}`, such a signal still shows its value; in a condition, an attribute or an expression, `kay check` reports it with the call to write. Props and server data are plain names everywhere: `{title}`, not `{title()}`.
- A `for` matches its rows across renders by `item.id`, else by the item itself, so a list of objects with no `id`, made afresh on each render, names a key: `for post of posts key={post.slug}`; `kay check` warns of such a list in an island (`identity-key`).
- A promise an `await` block renders by the name a server fence declares it under, `await comments`, is left unawaited and kay defers it; any other, such as `await data.comments` or one a component makes, is made with `defer()`.
- The component script exports types only. Shared values live in `.ts` modules.
- A page has no props: its data comes from its `--- server` fence.
- `window`, `document`, `localStorage` and the other globals only a browser has are read in `effect` or `onMount`, or in a component whose script fence is `--- client`; reading one while rendering throws on the server.
- Durations kay's config and server code take are seconds as a number, or a number with its unit as a string, `'30s'`, `'5m'`, `'1.5h'`, `'30d'` or `'2w'` (type `Duration` from `kay`): `cached`'s `ttl`, `revalidate`, a session's `maxAge`, `rateLimit`'s `window` and `shutdownTimeout`. Each must be positive, which `kay check` reports for a literal `cached` ttl and the server for the rest. Only `kay/test`'s browser `timeout` is in milliseconds, as `bun:test`'s own timeouts are; a store's `set(id, data, maxAge)` gets seconds.
- Indentation is spaces only, consistent within a block. Text after a tag needs one space: `p Hello`, never `p:Hello`.
- Pug features that do not exist: `- code` lines, `#{}` and `!{}` interpolation, `+mixins`, `include`, `extends`, `block`, filters, `&attributes`, `case`, `each`, `while`, `unless`, `doctype`; a line starting with one is reported, with what kay writes instead.

## Docs

Each topic is a file of its own: read the one a task touches before writing code for it.

- [Components](llms/components.md): the fences of a `.kay` file, props, signals, memos, effects, generic components, and shipping components in a package
- [Template lines](llms/templates.md): the indented template syntax: elements, classes, attributes, events, bindings, `if`/`for`/`await`/`try` blocks, slots
- [Head and site metadata](llms/head.md): `head` in templates, site-wide SEO defaults and social cards, sitemap and robots.txt, favicon and web manifest, offline service worker, self-hosted fonts
- [Styles and assets](llms/styles-and-assets.md): component styles and Tailwind, `public/`, imported images, fonts and files, responsive images, Iconify icons
- [Islands and navigation](llms/islands.md): what runs in the browser: islands, shared and persisted state, transitions, error fallbacks, context, unique ids, browser-only components, and in-place page navigation
- [Pages and routing](llms/routing.md): file-based routes, params, layouts, the server fence and `ctx`, prerendering and server islands, redirects, rewrites, base path, static export
- [Content collections](llms/content.md): Markdown, JSON and YAML collections read against a schema, loaders for a CMS or a database, preview mode for drafts
- [Locales](llms/locales.md): i18n: locale prefixes, typed messages, number and date formatting, redirecting a visitor to their locale
- [Caching and streaming](llms/rendering.md): caching rendered pages and data, streaming deferred values with `await` blocks, `renderToString` for mails and feeds
- [Actions](llms/actions.md): form posts that work without JavaScript and calls from islands, typed by a schema: validation errors, files, redirects, rate limits
- [Locals, sessions and guards](llms/server.md): per-request `ctx.locals`, cookie sessions and their stores, a typed `defineEnv`, `_guard.ts` route guards
- [API routes](llms/api-routes.md): Elysia modules under `src/api/`, server-sent events, websockets and rooms, and reading them typed from islands
- [Testing](llms/testing.md): `kay/test`: rendering pages and posting actions in `bun test`, browser tests
- [Checks and lints](llms/checks.md): what `kay check` reports, every lint at its default level and how to change it, ESLint on `.kay` files
- [Project setup and commands](llms/project.md): `kay.config.ts`, tsconfig, editor setup, and every `kay` CLI command and template
- [Running in production](llms/production.md): request logs, tracing and Server-Timing, health checks and graceful shutdown, cron and background jobs, running behind a proxy, security headers and CSP, compression
